To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the 3,4-diol moiety of 2,2′,5,5′-tetraphenyl-1,1′-binaphthyl-4,4′-diol (BINOL) was replaced by two thiophene-2,3-diol moieties, and that the resulting 2,2,5,5-tetraphenyl-bis-thiophene diol was found to be an atropisomeric diol

the enantioselectivity and the racemization barrier for a new class of bihetero-aromatic C2-symmetric diols were investigated and the racemisation mechanism was proposed and supported by experimental evidence.

the 2,2,5,5-tetraphenyl-bithienol (1) is the first example of a C2-symmetric biheteroarene diol with an enantioselectivity barrier that is high enough to allow the separation and collection of both enantiomers at semi-preparative scale, while its racemization barrier is high enough to permit its use in asymmetric catalysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of new chiral atropoisomerase diols based on the bithiophene scaffold and the investigation of the factors that control the enantiomerizations of these new compounds.
the design and synthesis of new C2-symmetric chiral bis-hetero-aromatic diols based on the 3,2':3',2"-terthiophene scaffold.

the synthesis of chiral C _{2} -symmetric diols based on biheteroaryl scaffolds, which might find application in asymmetric catalysis, and in the design of novel chiral ligands for enantioselectivity enhancement in organic reactions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the racemization mechanism of bithiophene diols is a combination of a 1,5-sigmatropic shift and a 1,3-proton transfer, which is the same mechanism proposed for the enantiomerizations of 2,2'-bithiols.
3,3',4,4'-tetraphenyl-bithienol is the first member of the new class of BITHIENOL chiral atropoisomerase promoters.

the 3,2',3'-trisubstituted-3,3-bithiophene skeleton is the most promising scaffold for the design of new chiral diols, which are suitable for the development of new enantioselectively catalyzed reactions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

BITHIENOL is a new promising chiral C2- symmetric atropisomerizable diol, whose racemization barrier can be increased by proper substitution, to the level required for application in asymmetric catalysis, but whose enantiomerization mechanism still needs to be further clarified.
the 2,2'-disubstituted 3,3' bithiophene scaffold is a promising candidate for the design of chiral promoters for asymmetric catalysis.
the 2,2'-disubstituted 3,3' bithiophene scaffold is a promising platform to design new C2-symmetric diols with enhanced configurational stability.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the bithiophene scaffold can be used to design new chiral C2- symmetric diols with a high enantiomerization barrier, thus providing a new class of atropoisomeres that could be used as chiral promoters for asymmetric catalysis.
2,2'-disubstituted 3,3-bithiophene scaffolds can provide a new class of C2-symmetric diol ligands with high enantioselectivity in asymmetric transformations.

the enantiomerically pure 3,3′-bithiophenes are stable and that the 2,2′-dihydroxyl groups can be used as a chiral auxiliary to control the stereochemistry in the reactions of a wide range of organic substrates.
